automata_07_right_hand.title: Right-Hand Rule
automata_07_right_hand.summary: Navigate through a maze without islands by hugging the right wall all the way to the goal.

recursion_15_tremaux.summary: Explore a branching maze: recursively search pathways and backtrack out of dead ends.

recursion_16_fractal_tree.title: Karel's Fractal Fern
recursion_16_fractal_tree.summary: Draw a recursive branching binary tree of beepers.
